title: Additivity of the discrete derivative
statement:
Fix an arity $n$ and a coordinate direction $i \in \{1, \dots, n\}$. For any two Boolean functions $f, g : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$, the discrete derivative in direction $i$ satisfies
\[
  D_i(f + g) = D_i f + D_i g,
\]
that is, the operator $D_i$ is additive.
hypotheses_covered: direction i among the n coordinates
two Boolean functions f, g of arity n
replaced:
The discrete derivative respects addition:
$D_i(f + g) = D_i f + D_i g$.
